Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.fws.awt

Class WinSysAWT

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.fws.FoundationWinSys
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.fws.awt.WinSysAWT
public class WinSysAWT extends FoundationWinSys
Implementation of the FoundationWinSys with AWT to interface between the Display Server and Java base clients using AWT events. A FoundationWinSys implementation using AWT for use in development when the X11 integration is not required or when the underlying platform is not X based.

    • trackEventsForNativeWindow

      public void trackEventsForNativeWindow(long wid)
      This allows the FWS to generate enter and exit events as the pointer is moved in and out of the native window. It also allows the FWS to provide click-to-front behavior for the interior of the native window.
      Specified by:
      trackEventsForNativeWindow in class FoundationWinSys
      Parameters:
      wid - The window ID of the native window
